SWAN RIVER CHILDREN'S HEALTH SERVICE General Paediatrics Outpatients, Level 3, 40 Hardey Road, Subiaco WA 6008, Australia
LETTER TO SCHOOL - MEDICAL
28 July 2094
The Principal Glendalough College 12 Coolgardie Terrace Mount Lawley WA 6050
Attention: Mr Desmond Aldous-Penn, Head of Year 10 Re: Jakub Wisniewski-Hart, born 14.09.2078, Year 10, house Kingfisher
Dear Mr Aldous-Penn,
I am writing at the request of Jakub's mother, Ms Eleanor Hart, to explain why Jakub has been away from school and will need adjustments over the coming term. Jakub was seen in our emergency department on the 22nd of July having injured his chest in a fall while skateboarding, and he was found to have a fractured rib. This is a painful but, in a boy of his age, generally uncomplicated injury, and the expected time to full healing is in the order of six to twelve weeks. As of today he is walking and attending to his usual self-care, but he can not carry a heavy bag and should not take part in physical education, contact sport or the September cross country carnival, nor sit on the school bus on rough roads for long periods if avoidable. I would ask the school to allow him a locker near his first class, extra time to move between classrooms and, where possible, rest breaks.
There is no reason for him to be excluded from classroom learning, and I would be grateful if you could let his teachers know. I have also noted that Jakub, whom his friends call Kuba, has had a stressful year in other respects, and the school counsellor, Ms Rosalind Achebe, may like to check in with him. I am sharing no further details without his permission.
I will review him again in about mid-October and send a second letter. Please call the clinic on (08) 5550 0188 or fax (08) 5550 0199 if you need anything. His father, Marek Wisniewski, is overseas in the Netherlands for work but can be reached by email at m.wisniewski@noordhaven-marine.example.
Yours sincerely,
[signature] Dr Callum Strathairn Consultant Paediatrician, Swan River Children's Health Service Provider number 4417829K
cc: Ms Hart; file WISNIEWSKI-HART J JW 1409-78 Dictated but not read. Typed by Priyanka Rao (secretary), file name Wisniewski-Hart_J_school_letter_28-07-94.docx
